headline: A 2002 executive order directs federal agencies to properly consider small entities when they write new rules.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to give proper attention to how their proposed rules would affect small entities. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, duties, or deadlines it sets for agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to consider effects on small entities during the rulemaking process.

who_it_affects.group: Small entities, such as small businesses
who_it_affects.how: Their situation is meant to be taken into account when agencies create new federal rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 13, 2002; no separate effective date was provided.
